description: Eight neonates each have a general anaesthetic whose mean pressures test how long a pressure below 40 stands: ten arterial readings below 40 a minute apart, with a death 30, 90 or 91 days after the date of the start, a low cuff reading followed by the next reading 20 minutes later, low readings ten minutes before the start and an hour after the end, a low last reading two minutes before the end, a low last reading of an anaesthetic with no recorded stop, and a cuff mean of 35 beside an arterial mean of 50 with the same time.
